blocks.text: 今天我们宣布，OpenAI 将收购 Pierre Computer Company, Inc⁠（在新窗口打开）（简称“Pierre”）。这家公司打造了 Code Storage⁠（在新窗口打开），以及一系列出色的开源开发者工具。如果你曾在 Codex 应用中浏览文件或审查改动，其实已经用过 Pierre 的 Trees 和 Diffs 库。我们很高兴能与 Pierre 团队合作，在开发者早已依赖的 Git 工作流基础上继续构建，并让这些工作流适应团队与编程智能体协作的方式。

inlines.text: 今天我们宣布，OpenAI 将收购

，以及一系列出色的开源开发者工具。如果你曾在 Codex 应用中浏览文件或审查改动，其实已经用过 Pierre 的 Trees 和 Diffs 库。我们很高兴能与 Pierre 团队合作，在开发者早已依赖的 Git 工作流基础上继续构建，并让这些工作流适应团队与编程智能体协作的方式。

blocks.text: 在我们自己的工程实践中，随着越来越多的工作并行推进，我们清楚地看到 Git 周边的系统也需要随之演进。本周早些时候，我们分享了如何借助 Pando 在 OpenAI 扩展 Git——Pando 是我们为工程师和智能体打造的自研源代码管理后端。有了 Pierre 团队，我们希望为现代软件开发树立标准：从智能体创建的第一个分支，一直到代码部署上线的那一刻。我们希望让 Codex 成为开发者和智能体开展最宏大项目的地方。

blocks.text: 我们一直欣赏 Pierre 在 Git 的另一环节——开发者审查代码——上所倾注的用心。这份用心，从我们今天在 Codex 中使用的库就能看出来。Trees 让开发者快速浏览项目文件，Diffs 则让改动一目了然。这两个工具都能以毫不妥协的性能，轻松应对海量代码的审查与浏览。

inlines.text: 我们一直欣赏 Pierre 在 Git 的另一环节——开发者审查代码——上所倾注的用心。这份用心，从我们今天在 Codex 中使用的库就能看出来。Trees 让开发者快速浏览项目文件，Diffs 则让改动一目了然。这两个工具都能以毫不妥协的性能，轻松应对海量代码的审查与浏览。

blocks.text: 同样的细致也贯穿于 Pierre 的其他工作。Diffs 的编辑模式让审查者能在发现问题的那一行就地修改代码。Pierre 最近发布了Highlights，这是一款速度极快的语法高亮工具，会随着开发者输入或智能体流式输出代码而实时更新。把编辑器放进 diff 的，正是这支小团队；他们还为 Code Storage 设计了 API——这项服务让应用能够存储代码，并用 Git 追踪其历史。

blocks.text: 在 Codex 中汇聚各项工作

inlines.text: 在 Codex 中汇聚各项工作

blocks.text: Pierre 打造了开发者喜爱的工具，我们将携手推出惠及所有人的新产品和新平台。收购完成后，我们的目标是推动整个行业源代码管理的未来发展。我们希望让 Codex 把公司交付的代码与员工所做的决策连接起来，并达到未来所需的规模。

inlines.text: Pierre 打造了开发者喜爱的工具，我们将携手推出惠及所有人的新产品和新平台。收购完成后，我们的目标是推动整个行业源代码管理的未来发展。我们希望让 Codex 把公司交付的代码与员工所做的决策连接起来，并达到未来所需的规模。

blocks.text: Pierre 的开源项目将继续保持开源，我们也会持续为其贡献代码。收购完成后，客户仍可继续使用 Code Storage，同时我们会努力将其特性和功能引入 Codex。

inlines.text: Pierre 的开源项目将继续保持开源，我们也会持续为其贡献代码。收购完成后，客户仍可继续使用 Code Storage，同时我们会努力将其特性和功能引入 Codex。

blocks.text: 本次收购的完成取决于惯例成交条件，包括获得监管批准。在交易完成之前，OpenAI 与 Pierre 仍将是各自独立的两家公司。

blocks.text: Today we're announcing that OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc⁠(opens in a new window). (“Pierre”), the company behind Code Storage⁠(opens in a new window) and a family of standout open-source developer tools. If you’ve browsed files or reviewed a change in the Codex app, you’ve already used Pierre’s Trees and Diffs libraries. We’re excited to work with the Pierre team to build on the Git workflows that developers already rely on and adapt them to how teams work with coding agents.

inlines.text: Today we're announcing that OpenAI will acquire
Pierre Computer Company, Inc⁠(opens in a new window)
. (“Pierre”), the company behind
Code Storage⁠(opens in a new window)

and a family of standout open-source developer tools. If you’ve browsed files or reviewed a change in the Codex app, you’ve already used Pierre’s Trees and Diffs libraries. We’re excited to work with the Pierre team to build on the Git workflows that developers already rely on and adapt them to how teams work with coding agents.

blocks.text: We’ve seen in our own engineering work how the systems around Git need to evolve as more of that work happens in parallel. Earlier this week, we shared how we’re scaling Git at OpenAI with Pando, our in-house source control backend for engineers and agents. With the Pierre team, we wish to set the standard for modern software development: from the first branch an agent creates to that magic moment when code is deployed to the world. We want to make Codex the place where developers and agents take on their most ambitious projects.

blocks.text: Craftsmanship meets scale for the agentic era

inlines.text: Craftsmanship meets scale for the agentic era

blocks.text: We’ve long appreciated the care Pierre brings to another part of working with Git: how developers review code. You can see that care in the libraries we use in Codex today. Trees lets developers quickly navigate a project’s files, and Diffs makes it easy to see what changed. Both of these tools make it easy to review and navigate large volumes of code with uncompromising performance.

inlines.text: We’ve long appreciated the care Pierre brings to another part of working with Git: how developers review code. You can see that care in the libraries we use in Codex today. Trees lets developers quickly navigate a project’s files, and Diffs makes it easy to see what changed. Both of these tools make it easy to review and navigate large volumes of code with uncompromising performance.

blocks.text: That same attention to detail runs through Pierre’s other work. Diffs’ Edit mode lets a reviewer fix a line of code right where they spot the problem. Pierre recently released Highlights, an extremely fast syntax highlighter that updates as a developer types or an agent streams code. The same small team that put an editor inside a diff also designed the API for Code Storage, a service that lets apps store code and track its history using Git.

blocks.text: Bringing the work together in Codex

inlines.text: Bringing the work together in Codex

blocks.text: Pierre has built tools that developers love, and together, we will ship new products and platforms that benefit all. Once the acquisition closes, our ambition is to advance the future of source control across the industry. We want Codex to connect the code a company ships with the decisions its people make, at the scale the future demands.

Once the acquisition closes, our ambition is to advance the future of source control across the industry. We want Codex to connect the code a company ships with the decisions its people make, at the scale the future demands.

blocks.text: Pierre’s open-source projects will remain open-source, and we’ll continue to contribute to them. Customers can continue using Code Storage after the acquisition closes while we work to bring its features and functionality into Codex.

blocks.text: The closing of the acquisition is subject to customary closing conditions, including receipt of regulatory approvals. Until closing, OpenAI and Pierre will remain separate and independent companies.
